# Josh Winningham

> Digital marketing, SEO and AI visibility, and web development, based in the Phoenix, AZ area and working remotely. 18+ years running online businesses (email audience of 39,200+ subscribers, an online course sold to 670+ customers, first-page Google rankings for national keywords), combined with hands-on development of the websites and web products themselves. Founder of Scale Visibility. Open to remote digital marketing, SEO, website optimization, marketing technology, and full-stack development roles.

Marketing and SEO: technical SEO, local SEO, structured data (Schema.org / JSON-LD), metadata and sitemaps, AI citation testing and AI crawler access, Core Web Vitals, email marketing, content marketing, Google Business Profile.

Primary stack: React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Drizzle ORM, Supabase, Stripe, Vercel, WordPress. Also C#, ASP.NET Core, Python, Flask, Astro, AWS. AI-assisted development with OpenAI Codex, Claude Code, and Cursor.

## Production products

- [Scale Visibility](https://app.scalevisibility.com/): authenticated AI-search readiness audit platform with saved reports, citation testing, competitor benchmarking, Stripe billing, and six public readiness tools (Next.js, PostgreSQL, Supabase, Inngest)
- [It's an Art Party](https://www.itsanartparty.com/): multi-city provider directory marketplace with city-specific pages, LocalBusiness and ItemList structured data, sitemaps, provider self-service, free and sponsored listings, Clerk auth, Stripe billing, and lifecycle email (Next.js, PostgreSQL)
- [TrueTourney](https://www.truetourney.com/): youth sports tournament directory with scheduled data refreshes, director submissions, and registration-click reporting (Next.js, Node.js, Upstash Redis)
